worldcombat.skill.playrough.summary: Bound into the target and bowl it over with your whole body, shoving it back and possibly lowering its Attack by 1 stage; the romping form turns on a second nearby enemy.
worldcombat.skill.playrough.use.0: Charge in and knock a foe off its feet
worldcombat.skill.playrough.use.1: Bound back and forth between clustered enemies
The pounce deals about %1$s physical damage; when Romping, if another enemy stands within %3$s blocks of the impact it turns and deals about %2$s more.
Each target hit has a %1$s chance to lose %2$s stage(s) of Attack.
The pounce charges %1$s blocks at %2$s blocks/tick, shoving a hit target back about %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.playrough.romp.on: Romping: longer charge, faster roll, harder shove, wider reach to a second target, shorter wind-up and cooldown; the first hit is lighter and the turn-on hit slightly heavier (about the same total), and the Attack drop is rarer.
worldcombat.skill.playrough.romp.off: Solid tackle: a shorter charge; the first hit is heavier and the turn-on hit slightly lighter (about the same total), with a more reliable Attack drop.
worldcombat.skill.playrough.timing: Range %1$s blocks, wind-up %2$s, recovery %3$s, %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.playrough.growth.0: From level %1$s the pounce rises to %2$s power and the roll to %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.playrough.growth.1: From level %1$s the pounce rises to %2$s power and %3$s Attack-drop chance.
worldcombat.skill.playrough.preference.r: On: longer charge, faster roll, harder shove, wider roll-on range, shorter wind-up and cooldown; the first hit is lighter and the turn-on hit slightly heavier (about the same total), and the Attack drop is rarer. Off (solid tackle): a shorter charge with a heavier first hit and a slightly lighter turn-on hit (about the same total) and a more reliable Attack drop.
worldcombat.skill.playrough.preference.a: Beyond this distance the companion closes in before charging; larger values let it start from further away.
On: when Romping and another same-height, unobstructed enemy it can turn onto stands near the target, it charges in. Off (or solid tackle): ordinary melee ordering.
On: lower-health targets rank higher. Off: ordinary melee ordering.
The roll sweeps with a %1$s block hit radius and is stopped by terrain or a body in the way; it whiffs if it strikes no one.
